fields.title: Causal Inference for Epigenetic Ageing
fields.description: A perspective on applying causal inference methods to understand the relationship between epigenetic changes and the aging process.

descriptions.text: A perspective on applying causal inference methods to understand the relationship between epigenetic changes and the aging process.

This Tools of the Trade article describes epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization, which uses inherited genetic variants to test which DNA methylation sites in an epigenetic clock have potential causal links to lifespan and healthspan.

pdfFigures.legendFirstSentence: Epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization can identify causal epigenetic factors in ageing.
